image_format_note: Dataset viewer API supplies JPEG bytes. Initial loader used .png filenames; bytes are unchanged and decode as JPEG. Content sniffing was verified by file command and natural dimensions checked by browser. Preserve this baseline mapping; do not confuse it with original PNG dataset shards.
transformation: Viewer-delivered JPEGs, not original Parquet image-byte equivalence; API annotation fields retained unchanged. No original screenshots with real PII were requested.
signed_url_policy: Ephemeral asset query URLs were used for retrieval only and omitted from stored metadata. Stable repository revision and row index identify each source.
sample_limits: All selected rows are Amazon reproductions
Five deterministic contiguous ranges, not random population sampling
authors: Dataset/project currently attributed as WebPII; model repository citation lists Anonymous Authors. No personal author names invented.
